detail.title: Record {number}
detail.xmlPending: The XML is built when the record is sent to the AEAT.
detail.waitingWhen: It goes out by itself with the next pass, in order, and declared as late if it failed before. You do not have to do anything.
detail.rejectedHelp: If the invoice itself is wrong (a customer's tax ID the AEAT does not know, an amount), rectify it in Invoicing. If not (the chain after restoring a backup, a fault of ours), correct the record.
detail.correctMessage: A new record of the same invoice, read again, is sealed as a correction and goes to the AEAT. The rejected one is kept as it is.
detail.correctDone: Correction of {number} sealed: it goes out with the next pass.
detail.cancelNote: The AEAT will be told this invoice was issued by error. A refund or a correction is never this: it is a rectifying invoice in Invoicing. The invoice stays in Invoicing.
detail.cancelDone: Cancellation of {number} sealed: it goes out with the next pass.
detail.reasonRequired: Write why the invoice was issued by error.

recovery.title: Chain recovery
recovery.scope: This recomputes the SHA-256 fingerprints and verifies the chaining. It does not re-audit the amounts: the base, the tax and the total are taken as the invoice declared them.
recovery.manualHint: Paste the last fingerprint (64 hex) of your previous application, with its invoice number and date, to continue the same chain.
recovery.hashInvalid: The fingerprint must be 64 hexadecimal characters
recovery.confirmAeatTitle: Recover the chain from the AEAT
recovery.confirmAeatMessage: Local continuity will be rebuilt from the latest record available at the AEAT. Verify the issuer tax ID before continuing.
recovery.confirmManualTitle: Continue the chain from an external fingerprint
recovery.confirmManualMessage: The fingerprint given will be the predecessor of the next fiscal record. Use this only during a migration and with the data of the last record of the previous application.
recovery.failed: The operation could not be done

settings.title: VeriFactu settings
settings.ownOn: You file directly with the tax agency using your business certificate, uploaded in Configuration → My certificate.
settings.ownOff: ERPlora files your billing records with the tax agency on your behalf, with its own seal. You do not need a certificate.
settings.routeOwn: Done: from now on you send with your own certificate.
settings.routeErplora: Done: from now on ERPlora files on your behalf.
settings.goLiveHint: Your invoices go to the AEAT's test environment. When everything is ready, go live.
settings.goLiveTitle: Send your invoices to the AEAT for real?
settings.goLiveMessage: From now on every record goes to the real AEAT. As soon as the first one is sealed you can no longer go back to testing.
settings.wentLive: Your business is live: records now go to the real AEAT.
settings.issueBlocked: New sales and invoices are refused until this is fixed:
settings.backHint: No record has been sealed in production yet, so you can still go back to testing.
settings.backTitle: Go back to the test environment?
settings.backMessage: Records will go to the AEAT's test environment again and will not count before the tax agency.
settings.backDone: Your business is back in the test environment.
settings.oneWay: Your business already has records in production, so it cannot go back to testing.
settings.testHint: Checks everything needed to send, without presenting anything to the AEAT: a filed record cannot be undone.
settings.testTestingOnly: The test invoice is only for the test environment.
settings.testCreated: Test invoice {number} created: its record is in Records.
settings.declarationDesc: The declaration ERPlora signs for the version of the system you are running, and the identifying data every record carries.
settings.loadError: The settings could not be loaded

grant.intro: ERPlora files your invoicing records with the tax authority ON YOUR BEHALF. Spanish law needs your signed consent for that: the official form of the colaboración social agreement. You download it, sign it away from this screen, and upload it back.
grant.issuerMissing: Set up the issuer first in Invoicing → Issuer: it is who owes the tax.
grant.notLinked: ERPlora has not linked this business yet: you can send it once your ERPlora account has sent its data.
grant.step1Hint: Its wording is set by the tax authority and cannot be changed: fill in the details of your business and of whoever signs.
grant.downloaded: Model downloaded. Sign it and upload it below.
grant.howToByHand: By hand: print it, sign it, stamp it with the company seal if your business is a company, and scan it back to PDF.
grant.howToElectronic: Electronically: sign the PDF with AutoFirma using your own qualified certificate. A drawn signature is not accepted.
grant.privacyController: Controller: ERPLORA CLOUD SL (B27593136). We hold these documents as your representative.
grant.privacyPurpose: Purpose and basis: to file your invoicing records with the Spanish tax authority on your behalf, under the authorisation you sign and our legal duties. We keep them while the representation lasts and for the tax retention periods.
grant.privacyRights: Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection and portability at privacy{'@'}erplora.com.
grant.step2Hint: A person at ERPlora checks it and emails you within 24-72 hours. Each file is a PDF of 5 MB at most.
grant.legalRepresentativeHint: The person who signs on behalf of the company, as named in its deeds. Their ID copy is the one uploaded below.
grant.signerName: Full name of the person signing
grant.signerNif: ID number of the person signing

choose.id_copy: Attach a copy of the ID (PDF)

grant.signatureSampleWhy: A NIE often carries no printed signature, so we need a sheet with your handwritten signature to compare it against.
grant.representationProofWhy: Your business is a company, so we need the document that names the person allowed to sign for it.
grant.sentToast: Sent for review. We let you know by email within 24-72 hours.
grant.tooLarge: Each file has to be 5 MB at most.
grant.unreadableFile: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
grant.failed: It did not work. Try again.
grant.resendHintPending: If something came out wrong, send it again: the new submission replaces the one under review.
grant.resendHintInForce: While we review the new submission, you keep filing with the current one.

errors.signer_required: Fill in the name and ID number of the person signing.
errors.document_type_invalid: Pick the kind of identity document.
errors.signed_model_not_pdf: The signed form has to be a PDF — scan it or sign it with AutoFirma.
errors.id_copy_required: Attach a copy of the identity document.
errors.signature_sample_required: With a NIE we also need a sample of your handwritten signature.
errors.representation_proof_required: Attach the document that proves you may sign for the company.
errors.document_too_large: Each file has to be 5 MB at most.
errors.document_not_pdf: Each file has to be a PDF.
errors.taxpayer_tax_id_invalid: Invoicing’s issuer has no valid Spanish tax ID: correct it in Invoicing → Issuer.
errors.body_too_large: The files together weigh too much: send smaller scans.
errors.payload_too_large: The files together weigh too much: send smaller scans.
errors.hub_unregistered: ERPlora has not linked this business yet. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.issuer_missing: Set up the issuer first in Invoicing → Issuer: it is who owes the tax.
errors.saas_unreachable: ERPlora could not handle this right now. Try again in a few minutes.
